matched_residual_complete.expected: Valid residual near 1.2 kWh; the check follows the evidence, not the scenario name.

matched_residual_incomplete.expected: Residual stays null and data repair is recommended; a missing reading is never zero-filled.

matched_residual_stale_mapping.expected: Comparable apparent excess routed to a mapping and model check, not a loss dispatch.

matched_residual_model_shift.expected: Comparable apparent excess from an elevated technical loss alone; no unmetered load is injected.

G.name: Matched apparent residual
G.purpose: Hold the displayed imbalance comparable while varying evidence quality, so the recommended next check must follow the observed evidence rather than the scenario name.

H.name: Sparse metering rollout
H.purpose: Feeder and consumer metering only, so no branch localization is supported and the system must declare an observability gap.

coverage_profiles.note: Installed-inventory profiles applied to a fictional network. Published counts describe metering installation at one date for a real utility; they do not establish communication health, mapping correctness, or any tested deployment.
sources: CEA, Status of Metering in the Country, reference date 31 March 2025
